text:
sam: quick async — canary at 3% (30m). overall QPS looks steady but eu-west-1 tail P99 jumped ~120ms after the deploy, unsure if KV cache churn or a routing blip :thinking:
anya: looking now, can you post the trace id or a sample request id? also which feature flag variant is live? :eyes:
sam: flag `fastpath_v2` = ON for canary slice. sample trace: trace-9a2f, saw spike at token-generation step. no obvious error logs.
keith: re: kv cache, we had a config change last night reducing shard-size to save memory. might be causing more evictions under certain seq lengths. can someone run the 'kv_stats' query on the canary hosts? e.g.:
```
ssh infra@canary-eu-1
curl http://localhost:9100/metrics | grep kv_cache_evictions
```
rachel: tagging infra, but FYI deploy PR #4321 is still waiting one LGTM for the rollback helper. i've left comments on the PR — pinged @keith for the final review.
deploy-bot: Canary rollout: 3% -> 3% (stable). No infra alerts. Metric anomaly detected: eu-west-1 p99 +80ms vs baseline (last 1h).
sam: thanks. current blockers: can't reproduce locally, need targeted kv stats from canary hosts + a heap of traces from the p99 window. also need decision on whether to pause and revert the config change.
anya: I'll grab kv stats and attach a short snippet here in ~10m. also will pull top-50 traces by latency. any specific user-facing endpoints to prioritize?
keith: prioritize generation endpoints (/v1/generate, /v1/chat/stream). those use the same runtime path that touches kv cache heavily. i'll also run a quick canary host restart on a single replica to see if warm caches recover — will do as a controlled experiment.
sebastian: if restarts remove the spike, it's likely eviction/warmup. if not, might be kernel scheduling or a routing perf regression. i'm going to check infra-level CPU steal and context-switch counters for the timeframe.
rachel: from product side no high-severity user reports yet. we can hold at 3% while we debug — ops preference? :thumbsup: to hold, :arrow_right: to ramp.
sam: hold for now. if we get strong evidence it's kv eviction we can try increasing shard-size back to previous config on the canary slice only.
keith: noted. PR for revert ready if needed (PR #4330). i'm on review now.
anya: pasted kv eviction snippet: `canary-eu-1a: kv_evictions_total{shard="s0"}=120, kv_evictions_total{shard="s1"}=5` — looks concentrated in s0. further digging now.
sebastian: i'm seeing small but correlated CPU steal spikes on the same host at the times of the p99 events. forwarding host logs to this thread.
deploy-bot: Observability hook: created ticket #OPS-789 for cross-team follow-up; linked traces and host logs.
sam: thanks all. Action items: (1) keith to try single-replica restart experiment (2) anya to assemble top traces + post them (3) sebastian to confirm infra metrics and thundercat (4) rachel to hold ramp and coordinate with product comms if we revert. i'll update thread after experiment.
keith: starting controlled restart in 2m, will report back with timings + before/after p99.
anya: will upload traces in ~12m.
sebastian: will correlate with cloud hypervisor events and post summary.
rachel: staying on pause, thx. :white_check_mark:
